verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Query API that returns the same calculated report results as the web app, plus JQL for custom JavaScript queries, which covers running analytical queries. It also documents a Raw Event Export API that returns all event properties as JSONL and is recommended for high-volume exports, which covers pulling raw event data. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the query/export APIs, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found all candidate paths returning 404).

support.subject: As a developer, I can run analytical queries and pull raw event data back through a documented query/export API

citations.quote: To export raw event data, use the Raw Event Export API. The events payload is returned as JSONL
The raw export API allows you to download your event data as it is received and stored within Mixpanel, complete with all event properties
The Query API allows you to obtain the same calculated and formatted results that you see from a report in our web app.
The Mixpanel Query API endpoints can: Filter or break down Events
The JQL JavaScript code must define a main() function. This JavaScript will be compiled, and the main() function will be executed by the query engine.
